outcome: Pelvic Floor Distress Inventory Questionnaire-20 (PFDI-20) score
cohort: 201 parous women attending the outpatient gynaecology clinic at a hospital in the Tibet Autonomous Region between June 2022 and August 2022
finding: Pelvic floor disorder is common among parous women living in the Tibet Autonomous Region, and ethnicity, parity, history of heavy weight lifting, age, history of instrumental deliveries and number of caesarean sections are closely related to PFDI-20 scores.
mod_finding: This study found that a history of instrumental deliveries and the number of cesarean sections were correlated with pelvic floor disorder scores.
